_note: M11b portrait slot parameters (tools/gen_story.py). These are NOT final: the M11c art study picks the size and style. Per speaker: 'art' = a portrait .txt ('.-+#' = colours 0-3, whole tiles, up to 56x56) or none for a generated placeholder (a framed silhouette with the name, 'tint' its CGB palette, 'label' the name it shows); 'x', 'y' = screen tile of the picture's top-left (the frame takes one tile around it; default: column 2, the frame's bottom on row 12, right above the text box); 'palettes' = CGB BG palettes (#rrggbb x4, colour 0 first; at most 3 while a venue backdrop shows: BG slots 2-4); 'attr' = optional rows of digits, one per tile, the palette of each tile (default 0); 'overlay' = optional OBJ layer {art (8x16 cells, '.' transparent), x, y (px from the picture's top-left), palettes (CGB OBJ, up to 4: slots 3-6), dmg_obp 0/1}. NARRATOR has no portrait.
